verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents both building/deploying MCP servers on Workers (cloudflare-docs-12) and offers its own official, live remote MCP servers (Code Mode, Docs, Bindings, etc.) with documented URLs and OAuth/token auth (cloudflare-supp-mcp-fleet, cloudflare-supp-codemode-mcp), corroborated by independent live probes confirming a working keyless MCP server and an OAuth-gated MCP server per spec (cloudflare-probe-4, cloudflare-probe-5). This is both first-party docs and hands-on verification, fully satisfying the story.
